academic.passage: The study of ancient civilizations often reveals significant insights into human development. Mesopotamia, known as the cradle of civilization, contributed immensely to various fields including mathematics and law. Their innovations in irrigation transformed agriculture, allowing societies to flourish. This early civilization's achievements not only shaped their own society but also laid the groundwork for future cultures. A deeper understanding of such civilizations is crucial in grasping the complexities of modern human achievements.

questions.q: What is the main idea of the passage?
options: The contributions of Mesopotamia to various fields.
The history of ancient civilizations in general.
The agricultural practices of modern societies.
The role of art in Mesopotamian culture.
questions.explain: 這段話的主要意思是美索不達米亞對多個領域的貢獻，包括數學和法律。

questions.q: Which field did the Mesopotamians NOT contribute to, according to the passage?
questions.explain: 根據文本，美索不達米亞人在數學、天文學和法律方面做出了貢獻，但沒有提到醫學。

questions.q: What can be inferred about the impact of Mesopotamian culture?
options: It is irrelevant to modern civilization.
It laid important foundations for future cultures.
It was isolated from other civilizations.
questions.explain: 可以推斷，美索不達米亞文化為未來的文化奠定了重要的基礎，因為它的成就影響了當代文明。

questions.q: What does the term 'cradle of civilization' refer to?
questions.explain: '文明的搖籃'一詞指的是人類歷史的開始，特別是早期文明的發展。

daily.passage: Attention students! The annual campus clean-up day will take place this Saturday. Volunteers are needed to help with landscaping and waste removal. Snacks and drinks will be provided. Join us in keeping our campus beautiful!

questions.q: When is the campus clean-up day scheduled?
questions.explain: 通告中提到清理日是安排在本週六。

questions.q: What will be provided for volunteers during the event?
questions.explain: 志願者在活動期間將獲得小吃和飲料。
